summary: Tested admin login, JWT subject acceptance, protected dashboard, seeded stats, member creation/search, membership expiry, multiple payments, overpayment rejection, expiry filters, reports, mobile UI, and logout navigation. Core executed flows passed.

critical.issue: Logout only returns a message; the previously issued bearer token remains accepted by protected endpoints until expiry.

action_items: Implement token revocation/session invalidation or use an authenticated httpOnly cookie session so logout actually protects subsequent requests.
Consider replacing wildcard CORS with explicit configured origins if cookie credentials are introduced.
Settings Save currently has no persistence/API integration; verify whether this MVP feature is in scope.
critical_code_review_comments: The JWT subject fix is correct: token() stringifies user id and protected routes accept it.
Authentication uses localStorage bearer tokens and logout only removes the browser copy; stolen tokens remain valid for eight hours.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST Flow Member via API and TEST UI Member 2 via mobile UI for validation; these remain in development SQLite data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: JWT subject regression and mobile menu flow pass. Retest logout using the same captured token after revocation is implemented; settings persistence and assignment/payment UI are not exposed in the current frontend.
rca of the issue: Logout does not change server-side token state: /api/auth/logout returns a confirmation but auth() only verifies JWT signature/expiry and has no denylist or session store. Frontend localStorage removal logs out only that browser tab, not the token itself.
